queries_run: DoorDash customer concentration risk credit rating downgrade 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：2023–2025 年無任何客戶占營收 10% 以上；應收帳款中單一實體占比 2024 年底 13%、2025 年底 12%。
findings.excerpt: As of December 31, 2024, one entity individually accounted for 13% of accounts receivable, net. As of December 31, 2025, one entity individually accounted for 12% of accounts receivable, net. No customer accounted for 10% or more of revenue for the years ended December 31, 2023, 2024, and 2025.

findings.claim: 10-Q 2026-06-30：遵守信貸協議 covenant，無循環借款，信用狀 $117M；6/30 後全面修訂重述協議。
findings.excerpt: Agreement with certain lenders, which, as previously amended and restated on April 26, 2024, provided for an $800 million unsecured revolving credit facility maturing on April 26, 2029, with a sublimit for the issuance of letters of credit in an aggregate face amount of up to $600 million. As of June 30, 2026, we were in compliance with the covenants under the Existing Credit Agreement.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 搜尋未見 Moody's/S&P/Fitch 對 DASH 的評等行動或客戶倒閉/下修事件；10-Q(2026-06-30) 稱遵守信貸協議條款，但未逐字取得，不列 finding。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
